contains: ROS Noetic workspace /opt/fastlivo_ws (official FAST-LIVO2 build) and the entrypoint; the container writable layer (/datasets bags and per-run outputs) is NOT part of the image
datasets_note: Repopulate /datasets inside the container from this repository if the container is recreated, e.g. docker cp data/raw/Retail_Street_from_ros2_mirror.bag fastlivo2-ros1:/datasets/ ; docker cp data/derived/hilti_exp14_3topics.bag fastlivo2-ros1:/datasets/ ; docker cp data/derived/hilti_exp07_3topics.bag fastlivo2-ros1:/datasets/ ; docker cp data/derived/hilti_exp18_3topics.bag fastlivo2-ros1:/datasets/
